items.summary: Dussmann is interviewing housekeeping attendants on weekday mornings through 31 October, and is holding a technical walk-in on 17 October for MEP supervisors, team leaders, electricians, HVAC technicians and plumbers.
items.title: Dussmann FM walk-ins for housekeeping and MEP staff in Abu Dhabi and Dubai
items.where: Al Khazna Tower, Najda Street, Abu Dhabi; Oasis Center, Al Quoz 1, Dubai

items.summary: Whitespot Facilities Management is holding a one-day walk-in on Saturday 17 October, 10 AM to 2 PM, for road sweepers and office boys.
items.title: Whitespot FM walk-in for road sweepers and office boys

items.summary: Imdaad is holding another walk-in on Saturday 17 October, 10 AM to 2 PM, covering cleaning supervisors and machine operators, MEP, AC, BMS, electrical and civil technicians, and heavy-duty drivers.
items.title: Imdaad walk-in for cleaning supervisors and MEP technicians on 17 October

items.summary: DEWA says WETEX, running 20-22 October at Dubai World Trade Centre, will include a Health and Safety Conference with seven panels on workplace wellbeing, emergency preparedness and AI-driven safety in high-risk settings.
items.title: WETEX 2026 to host health and safety conference on AI and workplace risk

items.summary: The 12th WGES, organised by the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, DEWA and WGEO on 21-22 October, will examine how policy, regulation and carbon markets can turn green-economy targets into delivery.
items.title: World Green Economy Summit 2026 to focus on governance of the green transition
